$comment: Patient-facing strings for general_medicine v1, keyed by stable field id.
voice_prompt — spoken by TTS. Conversational, one idea per sentence.
touch_label  — short on-screen question. Must fit a large-type kiosk header.
help         — plain-language expansion, shown on tapping the help icon.
confirm      — read back to the respondent when the field is confirm_back or
when ASR confidence lands in the confirm band (§10).
Option labels come from clinical.json unless overridden here, so a code such
as 'diabetes' is translated once for every field that offers it.

gm.cc.primary_complaint.voice_prompt: What is the main problem that brought you to the hospital today? You can say it, or touch the picture that matches.
gm.cc.primary_complaint.touch_label: What is your main problem today?
gm.cc.primary_complaint.help: Choose the one problem that troubles you the most. You can tell the doctor about other problems later.
gm.cc.primary_complaint.confirm: You said your main problem is {answer}. Is that correct?

gm.cc.other_detail.voice_prompt: Please tell me in your own words what the problem is.
gm.cc.other_detail.help: Say or type it in your own words. There is no wrong answer.

gm.cc.duration_of_concern.voice_prompt: How long have you had this problem?
gm.cc.duration_of_concern.touch_label: How long have you had this?
gm.cc.duration_of_concern.help: Choose a number, then choose hours, days, weeks, months or years.

gm.hpi.site.voice_prompt: Where exactly do you feel it? Touch that part of the body on the screen.
gm.hpi.site.help: Touch the picture of the body where you feel it. You can choose more than one place.
gm.hpi.site.confirm: You showed me {answer}. Is that right?

gm.hpi.character.voice_prompt: How does it feel? You can choose more than one.
gm.hpi.character.help: Choose whatever comes closest. If none of these fit, choose 'I cannot describe it'.

gm.hpi.radiation.voice_prompt: Does the feeling spread anywhere else in your body?
gm.hpi.radiation.help: For example, some people feel chest pain moving into the arm or jaw.

gm.hpi.associated_symptoms.voice_prompt: Along with this, do you have any of these? You can choose more than one.
gm.hpi.associated_symptoms.help: These help the doctor understand how serious the problem may be. Choose all that you have.

gm.hpi.time_course.voice_prompt: Since it started, how has it changed?
gm.hpi.time_course.help: Think about whether it stays the same, comes and goes, or is getting worse.

gm.hpi.exacerbating.help: Choose all that apply. If nothing makes it worse, choose 'Nothing in particular'.

gm.hpi.relieving.help: Choose all that apply. If nothing helps, choose 'Nothing helps'.

gm.hpi.severity.voice_prompt: How bad is it right now? Zero means no trouble at all, and ten means the worst you can imagine. Touch the face that matches how you feel.
gm.hpi.severity.touch_label: How bad is it right now?
gm.hpi.severity.help: Slide or touch a face. There is no right or wrong answer — only how you feel.

gm.ros.constitutional.voice_prompt: In the last few weeks, have you had any of these?
gm.ros.constitutional.help: These are general body changes. Choose all that you have noticed, or choose 'None of these'.

gm.ros.cardiorespiratory.voice_prompt: Do you have any problem with your breathing or your heart?
gm.ros.cardiorespiratory.help: Choose all that apply, or choose 'None of these'.

gm.ros.gastrointestinal.voice_prompt: Do you have any problem with your stomach or digestion?
gm.ros.gastrointestinal.help: Choose all that apply, or choose 'None of these'.

gm.ros.genitourinary.voice_prompt: Do you have any problem when passing urine?
gm.ros.genitourinary.help: Choose all that apply, or choose 'None of these'.

gm.ros.neurological.voice_prompt: Have you had any of these problems with your head, nerves, or consciousness?
gm.ros.neurological.help: Choose all that apply, or choose 'None of these'.

gm.ros.musculoskeletal.voice_prompt: Do you have any problem with your joints, muscles or walking?
gm.ros.musculoskeletal.help: Choose all that apply, or choose 'None of these'.

gm.pmh.conditions.voice_prompt: Has a doctor ever told you that you have any of these illnesses?
gm.pmh.conditions.help: Choose all that a doctor has told you about, even if it is now controlled with medicine.
gm.pmh.conditions.confirm: So you have been told you have {answer}. Have I understood correctly?

gm.pmh.longest_condition_years.voice_prompt: How many years have you had the oldest of these illnesses?

gm.psh.had_surgery.voice_prompt: Have you ever had an operation?
gm.psh.had_surgery.help: This means any surgery, big or small, at any time in your life.

gm.psh.surgeries.help: Choose all that apply. If it is not on the list, choose 'Some other operation'.

gm.proc.procedures.voice_prompt: Have you ever had any of these tests or procedures?
gm.proc.procedures.help: These are tests or treatments done in a hospital. Choose all that apply, or 'None of these'.

gm.med.taking_medicines.voice_prompt: Are you taking any medicines at present?
gm.med.taking_medicines.help: Include tablets, injections, inhalers, drops, and any Ayurvedic or herbal medicine.

gm.med.list.voice_prompt: Please tell me the names of the medicines you take. If you do not know the names, you can show your prescription instead in the next step.
gm.med.list.help: Say or type whatever names you remember. You will also be able to photograph your prescription.
gm.med.list.confirm: I noted these medicines: {answer}. Is that correct?

gm.med.adherence.voice_prompt: Do you take these medicines as the doctor told you?
gm.med.adherence.help: Please answer honestly. It helps the doctor treat you correctly, and nobody will scold you.

gm.allergy.has_allergy.voice_prompt: This is an important question. Has any medicine or food ever caused you a reaction, such as a rash, swelling or difficulty breathing?
gm.allergy.has_allergy.help: An allergy means your body reacted badly to something — a medicine, an injection, a food, or dust.
gm.allergy.has_allergy.confirm: I have noted your answer about allergies as {answer}. Is that correct?

gm.allergy.substances.help: Choose all that apply. If you do not know the name of the medicine, say so — that is still useful.
gm.allergy.substances.confirm: You are allergic to {answer}. I will show this clearly to the doctor. Is that right?

gm.allergy.reaction.voice_prompt: What happened to you when you had the reaction?
gm.allergy.reaction.help: This tells the doctor how serious the allergy is. Choose all that happened.

gm.fh.conditions.voice_prompt: Has anyone in your close family — parents, brothers, sisters or children — had any of these?
gm.fh.conditions.help: Close family means parents, brothers, sisters and children. Choose all that apply.

gm.ph.tobacco.voice_prompt: Do you use tobacco in any form — smoking, or chewing?
gm.ph.tobacco.help: This includes cigarettes, beedi, hookah, gutkha, khaini and paan masala. Please answer honestly.

gm.ph.alcohol.help: This is only to keep you safe with medicines. Nobody will scold you.

gm.ph.diet.voice_prompt: What kind of food do you usually eat?
gm.ph.diet.help: Choose the one closest to your usual eating pattern.

gm.ph.physical_activity.voice_prompt: How active is your usual day?
gm.ph.physical_activity.help: Think about a normal working day for you.

gm.ph.sleep.help: Choose the one that best matches most nights.

gm.ph.occupational_exposure.voice_prompt: At your work, are you exposed to any of these?
gm.ph.occupational_exposure.help: Choose all that apply, or 'None of these'. This includes farm and construction work.

gm.ample.allergies.voice_prompt: Quickly — do you have any allergy to any medicine?
gm.ample.allergies.help: The nurse is coming to help you. Just a few quick questions.

gm.ample.medications.voice_prompt: Are you taking any medicine at present?
gm.ample.medications.help: Just yes, no, or not sure is enough.

gm.ample.past_history.voice_prompt: Do you have any of these conditions?
gm.ample.past_history.help: Choose all that apply. This helps the nurse help you faster.

gm.ample.last_oral_intake.voice_prompt: When did you last eat or drink anything?
gm.ample.last_oral_intake.touch_label: When did you last eat or drink?
gm.ample.last_oral_intake.help: This is important in case you need urgent treatment.

gm.ample.events.voice_prompt: How did this problem begin today?
gm.ample.events.help: Choose whatever is closest to what happened.
